interpretation.unit: One episode per task × condition × model; three researcher-constructed task families per paper.
interpretation.all_cells: P1 30 episodes including 6 single-session references; P2 24 episodes. Missing and invalid cells retained.
interpretation.decision_count: controller_turns + worker_decisions from the frozen analyzer; model decisions, not successful tool calls. Includes malformed model decisions. Scripted seed has no model decisions.
interpretation.pair_selection: All frozen valid task × model blocks and both levels of the other factor; no outcome-based selection. Single-session references are not factorial pairs.
interpretation.pair_direction: Positive means more recorded model decisions in the first-named condition; zero differences are plotted at zero.
interpretation.no_population_inference: No CI or significance test: one episode per cell, only three task families; matched comparisons reuse tasks.
interpretation.p1_boundary: Identity wording changes attribution within the same actual topology. Ledger also supplies fresh state; not a pure formatting treatment.
interpretation.p2_boundary: 2/4 roles count worker functions, excluding the common controller. Organization changes sessions/handoffs jointly.
